title: Médico Geriatra | Duque de Caxias RJ | Banco de Talentos
description: Sobre a Vaga Na Laços Saúde, acreditamos que o cuidado deve ser um reflexo da individualidade de cada pessoa, promovendo a autonomia e a qualidade de vida dos nossos pacientes. Como parte do nosso compromisso com um modelo inovador de assistência, buscamos médicos geriátricos apaixonados pela transformação do cuidado à saúde no ambiente domiciliar, seguindo os princípios do modelo Buurtzorg, que prioriza o autocuidado e a manutenção das funcionalidades das pessoas em suas próprias comunidades. Qualificações Formação em Medicina com Residência em Geriatria, Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM). Experiência prévia em atenção domiciliar ou saúde comunitária será um diferencial. Paixão por promover o autocuidado e a autonomia dos pacientes, com abordagem centrada na pessoa. Habilidade em comunicação e empatia, fundamentais para estabelecimento de vínculos com pacientes e familiares. Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa e multidisciplinar, integrando ações que promovam a saúde do paciente no seu ambiente familiar. Proatividade na busca de soluções que promovam a qualidade de vida e a funcionalidade dos pacientes. Responsabilidades Atuar em consonância com os valores da organização, mantendo conduta focada em resultados do Cuidado, respeitando a individualidade de cada paciente e tornando a assistência personalizada. Registrar no Prontuário do Paciente as informações inerentes e indispensáveis ao processo de cuidado, mantendo-os atualizados. Ser representante da organização, zelando por suas premissas, prestando cuidado baseado em evidências científicas e melhores práticas. Realizar o Cuidado Integral ao Paciente, cuidando com empatia e carinho, estabelecendo vínculos e considerando as suas necessidades biopsicossociais. Garantir a continuidade da Assistência Médica por meio da execução do Plano de Cuidado estabelecido. Distribuir adequadamente a agenda de consultas, cumprindo a carga horária e número de atendimentos, conforme o contrato estabelecido. Sobre Nós Na Laços Saúde, a diversidade é o coração do nosso trabalho. Acreditamos que cuidar é um ato de amor e acolhimento, e isso se reflete em nossa equipe, que é composta por profissionais de diversas origens e experiências. O modelo Buurtzorg que adotamos é mais do que um método: é uma filosofia que prioriza o cuidado comunitário, respeitando a individualidade e as necessidades de cada pessoa. Aqui, cada dia é uma nova oportunidade de fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Gerente de tributação

Liderar auditorias locais e promover melhorias contínuas em políticas e processos tributários. Vivência anterior em uma das Big Four será considerada um diferencial. Experiência robusta em gestão tributária, compliance fiscal e planejamento tributário. Sólido conhecimento da legislação tributária, processos de auditoria e normas de reporte financeiro. Capacidade de atuar de forma colaborativa com equipes multidisciplinares de Finanças e áreas de negócio. Experiência na gestão de equipes de grande porte. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Clerkship Coordinator - Psychiatry
description: Benefits & Wellness Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture For more information visit Basic Function The Clerkship Coordinator is responsible for the day‑to‑day administrative and operational management of the medical student clerkship within the Department of Psychiatry. This position serves as a key member of the undergraduate medical education team and supports the Clerkship Director in ensuring an organized, compliant, student‑centered educational experience. The Clerkship Coordinator manages scheduling, evaluations, educational activities, accreditation‑related documentation, student communications, and clerkship operations across clinical training sites. The position requires a high degree of independence, professionalism, discretion, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced academic clinical environment. Supervisory Accountability Reports directly to the Clerkship Director. May provide operational guidance to student workers and administrative support staff involved in clerkship activities. Nature and Scope The Clerkship Coordinator works closely with faculty, residents, medical students, faculty practice, hospital and affiliate site personnel, curriculum administrators, and institutional leadership to support the successful operation of the clerkship program. Internal Contacts Clerkship Directors Faculty and residents Medical students Department administrators Curriculum and Dean’s Office personnel Information technology and educational support staff External Contacts Affiliate hospitals and clinical training sites Accreditation representatives and surveyors Vendors and educational software support personnel Clerkship Operations and Administration Coordinate and manage all administrative aspects of the clerkship program. Develop, maintain, adjust and distribute student rotation schedules, call schedules, orientation materials, and clerkship calendars. Coordinate student assignments to clinical teams, faculty, and affiliate sites. Ensure students receive timely onboarding information, institutional requirements, and site‑specific documentation. Maintain accurate student records, schedules, and educational documentation. Student Assessment and Evaluation Management Manage evaluation processes within educational management systems (e.g., E*Value or equivalent platforms). Assign and monitor student evaluations by faculty and residents. Track completion of evaluations and elevate delinquent evaluations as appropriate. Assist with collection and tracking of mid‑clerkship feedback to ensure compliance with institutional and LCME requirements. Coordinate examination administration, proctoring, grading support, and exam‑security procedures as assigned. Generate reports related to student performance, evaluations, grading, attendance, and clerkship metrics. Assist clerkship director with final grade compilation and submission deadlines. Accreditation and Compliance Support Assist the Clerkship Director with maintaining compliance with LCME accreditation standards and institutional educational policies. Maintain organized records and documentation related to accreditation, curriculum review, required clinical experiences, and student assessments. Assist with preparation of reports, surveys, annual reviews, and accreditation materials. Monitor student completion of required clerkship activities, logs, assignments, and educational requirements. Educational Activity Coordination Coordinate lectures, conferences, small groups, simulation activities, and other educational sessions. Reserve rooms/prepare virtual links, prepare educational materials, and provide logistical support for educational activities. Assist faculty with audiovisual and educational technology needs as appropriate. Maintain lecture archives and educational materials on Blackboard Learn or LMS. Communication and Student Support Serve as a primary administrative contact for medical students during the clerkship. Communicate policies, schedules, deadlines, and expectations to students and faculty. Address routine student concerns and elevate issues appropriately to clerkship leadership. Maintain professionalism and confidentiality in handling sensitive student and faculty matters. Administrative and Financial Support Assist with departmental administrative processes related to the clerkship program. Prepare reports, correspondence, spreadsheets, and presentations. Support tracking of program‑related expenditures and administrative documentation as assigned. Coordinate meetings and maintain meeting materials and records. Student Recommendation Letters & Residency Application Support Coordinate collection of materials for Department Chair letters, Clerkship Director letters, scholarship letters, and specialty‑specific evaluations. Maintain a tracking system for all requested letters. ERAS / Residency Application Support. Upload and manage letters through Electronic Residency Application Service ERAS. Ensure timely submission of: Chair letters Clerkship Director letters Letters of Recommendation Department forms Coordinate standardized letters such as SLOE when required. Confirm deadlines and specialty‑specific requirements. Confidentiality / Professionalism Maintain FERPA‑compliant handling of student records and confidential recommendation materials. Additional Responsibilities Participate in departmental, institutional, and clerkship coordinator meetings and professional development activities. Perform other related duties as assigned in support of undergraduate medical education programs. Core Competencies Knowledge of undergraduate medical education operations and accreditation standards preferred. Strong organizational and project management skills with attention to detail. Ability to prioritize and manage multiple deadlines simultaneously. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work collaboratively. Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise sound judgment. Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and educational management systems (e.g., E*Value, LMS platforms, exam software). Ability to analyze data and prepare reports. Ability to manage multiple deadlines and maintain accuracy in a fast‑paced, highly regulated educational environment. Minimum Requirements High school diploma or GED required. Minimum of 5 years of progressively responsible administrative, program coordination, healthcare, higher education, or medical education experience required. Or Associate degree and 3 years of relevant experience. Or Bachelor’s degree and 1 year of relevant experience. Experience in academic medicine, healthcare, higher education, or medical education preferred. Strong organizational, communication, and technology skills required. Experience with educational management systems and scheduling software preferred. Salary Range $55,000 - $60,000 Note: This position description should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as may be required. The university has the right to revise this position description at any time. This position description is not be construed as a contract for employment. Compliance Salary Range Disclosure #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Analista de Segurança da Informação Pleno
description: Somos uma consultoria de Engenharia de Software com mais de 15 anos de experiência em qualidade de software e elevado nível técnico quando se trata de automação de testes, segurança digital e cultura DevOps. nunca paramos de estudar e aprender , pois estamos sempre em busca de excelência e desenvolvimento. valorizamos nosso ambiente colaborativo , pois acreditamos na força do nosso time. agimos com transparência e respeito , pois buscamos manter padrões éticos e morais nas nossas relações com colegas, parceiros e clientes. Nosso time está crescendo. Formamos uma equipe comprometida com resultados e capaz de resolver problemas desafiadores. Venha crescer conosco! Como Analista de Segurança da Informação Pleno na PrimeUp você: Atuará em um projeto extensivo de transformação digital e inovação de uma multinacional do segmento de energia; Irá integrar o time de Engenharia de Detecção de Ameaças, atuando na criação, melhoria e sustentação de mecanismos de detecção em ambientes corporativos de segurança; Será responsável por correlacionar eventos de diferentes tecnologias de segurança e infraestrutura, contribuindo diretamente para o aumento da capacidade de detecção, resposta e maturidade da operação de segurança; Principais desafios: Criar, revisar e otimizar casos de uso para detecção de ameaças em soluções de SIEM. Desenvolver regras de correlação com base em eventos provenientes de diferentes fontes de log. Analisar padrões de ataques, técnicas, táticas e procedimentos utilizados por agentes maliciosos. Apoiar a evolução dos mecanismos de detecção com base em frameworks como MITRE ATT&CK, NIST e ISO 27001. Avaliar logs, eventos e alertas de diferentes tecnologias para identificar oportunidades de melhoria na detecção. Apoiar a integração de novas fontes de dados ao SIEM. Realizar tuning de regras, reduzindo falsos positivos e aumentando a efetividade dos alertas. Documentar casos de uso, lógicas de correlação, critérios de acionamento e procedimentos operacionais. Atuar em conjunto com times de SOC, resposta a incidentes, infraestrutura e arquitetura de segurança. Acompanhar tendências de ameaças, vulnerabilidades e técnicas de ataque para propor novas detecções. Para assumir esse desafio você precisa ter conhecimento e/ou experiência: Configuração, administração ou operação de soluções de SIEM; Criação de casos de uso para detecção de ameaças; Desenvolvimento ou manutenção de regras de correlação; Análise de logs e eventos de segurança; Conceitos de anatomia de ataques e ameaças em cybersegurança; Fundamentos sólidos de redes TCP/IP, protocolos, portas, serviços e comunicação entre sistemas; Sistemas operacionais Microsoft Windows Server e Linux Server; Tecnologias de segurança em ambientes corporativos, como firewall, EDR, antivírus, proxy, IAM, VPN, WAF, entre outras; Frameworks e boas práticas de segurança, como MITRE ATT&CK, NIST, CIS Controls e ISO 27001; Ensino superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança da Informação, Redes, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas relacionadas; No mínimo 2 anos de experiência em Segurança da Informação; Pelo menos 1 ano de experiência prática com alguma solução de SIEM; Capacidade de interpretar eventos de segurança e transformar análises em melhorias de detecção; Perfil analítico, investigativo e orientado à resolução de problemas; Capacidade de documentação técnica clara e objetiva. Será bacana se você também tiver: Certificações em Segurança da Informação, como: Security+, CySA+, CEH, SSCP, SC-200, AZ-500 ou similares. Conhecimento em IBM QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel, Splunk, Elastic Security ou outras soluções de SIEM. Conhecimento em gestão de vulnerabilidades. Experiência com Tenable, Nessus, Qualys, Rapid7 ou ferramentas similares. Familiaridade com inteligência de ameaças e fontes de IOC. Obs.: A vaga é remota para candidatos fora das regiões metropolitanas de RJ e SP. Para residentes nas regiões metropolitanas de RJ e SP, o modelo é híbrido (1 vez por semana presencial). Como um Primer você terá direito a: Contratação CLT com remuneração compatível ao mercado; Vale Alimentação; Vale Refeição; Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Folga Anual Bônus; Reembolso de Certificações; PrimeUp Academy (rede de capacitação profissional); Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR); Plano de academias; Programa de Bem-Estar com auxílio psicológico, social, financeiro e jurídico. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Experiência comprovada com plataformas de dados em nuvem, preferencialmente Google Cloud Platform (GCP); conhecimento em AWS ou Azure é desejável. Histórico de participação ativa em projetos de analytics, BI e ciência de dados. Conhecimentos Técnicos Cloud Computing, com foco em GCP; Domínio avançado em ferramentas de visualização: Tableau, Power BI e Looker (modelagem semântica; LookML é um diferencial); Proficiência em SQL avançado para modelagem, transformação e análise de dados; Experiência com GCP e seus serviços, especialmente BigQuery, Looker Studio, Dataflow e Cloud Storage; Conhecimento sólido em modelagem de dados analíticos (star schema, snowflake, modelagem dimensional); Proficiência em modelagem estatística e testes de hipóteses para analisar correlações e inferências em conjuntos de dados; Conhecimento de Python e bibliotecas de análise de dados (pandas, numpy); familiaridade com bibliotecas de machine learning e PySpark; Experiência na realização de testes A/B para avaliar o impacto de iniciativas e otimizações; Conhecimento de bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais; Habilidade em visualização de dados e storytelling; Capacidade para contribuir com insights analíticos a fim de aprimorar a experiência do usuário e do negócio. Além disso, realizará análises e acompanhará indicadores de desempenho, fornecendo insights que apoiem a tomada de decisões e contribuam para o crescimento sustentável dos negócios. Coordenação de Documentação e Suporte; Preparar documentos e relatórios para reuniões e apresentações, garantindo que as informações sejam claras e impactantes. Conhecimento de regulamentações do setor financeiro, como a LGPD (Lei Geral de Proteção de Dados), normas do Banco Central, e práticas de compliance aplicáveis a operações de crédito e seguros. Domínio de Excel e Google Sheets para análise de dados, elaboração de controles, relatórios e acompanhamento de indicadores. Há mais de 15 anos entregamos soluções através de sistemas de alta qualidade, seguros e de alto desempenho que movem a vida de milhares de pessoas. Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional com perfil analítico, organizado e estratégico para atuar na inteligência de mercado, relacionamento com clientes e apoio ao desenvolvimento de novos negócios. Essa pessoa será responsável por acompanhar o mercado de concessões e mobilidade, identificar oportunidades comerciais, manter relacionamento contínuo com clientes, analisar documentos de concorrências e apoiar a elaboração de propostas técnicas alinhadas às soluções da empresa. Buscamos alguém com excelente capacidade de comunicação, visão sistêmica do negócio, facilidade para interpretar documentos complexos e habilidade para conectar necessidades de mercado às capacidades dos produtos e serviços da Fadami. Se você gosta de entender cenários, construir relacionamentos, transformar informações em oportunidades e atuar próximo às áreas de produto, operações e diretoria, essa vaga é para você. Responsabilidades e atribuições Realizar mapeamento contínuo do mercado, identificando oportunidades de negócios, novos clientes, tendências e movimentos estratégicos do setor; Acompanhar publicações, portarias, regulamentações, grupos de trabalho, consultas públicas e discussões promovidas por agências reguladoras e entidades do segmento; Desenvolver e manter relacionamento com clientes no pós-venda, compreendendo cenários, desafios, oportunidades de evolução e percepção sobre os produtos e serviços da empresa; Consolidar feedbacks de clientes relacionados a funcionalidades, melhorias, problemas, riscos e oportunidades de expansão; Atuar como interface entre clientes, diretoria e equipes internas, garantindo o fluxo adequado de informações estratégicas; Manter histórico atualizado de clientes, produtos, projetos, contratos, oportunidades e iniciativas comerciais; Apoiar a elaboração e atualização de propostas técnicas, apresentações institucionais e materiais de apoio comercial; Realizar leitura, interpretação e animação de Termos de Referência (TR), Requests for Proposal (RFP), Requests for Information (RFI), Requests for Quotation (RFQ) e demais documentos de concorrências; Elaborar matrizes de aderência funcional, realizando cruzamento entre requisitos solicitados e funcionalidades dos produtos da empresa, classificando os itens como atende, atende parcialmente ou não atende; Elaborar questionamentos técnicos e comerciais durante processos concorrenciais; Construir respostas para esclarecimentos, diligências e questionamentos de clientes e órgãos contratantes; Apoiar o cadastramento e atualização de clientes, produtos, soluções e oportunidades comerciais em sistemas internos; Participar de reuniões com áreas de produto, desenvolvimento, operações e diretoria para alinhamento de estratégias e construção de propostas aderentes às necessidades do mercado; Produzir análises, relatórios e recomendações que apoiem decisões estratégicas e comerciais; Atuar no relacionamento com clientes corporativos e acompanhamento pós-venda. Requisitos e qualificações Experiência em análise de mercado, desenvolvimento de negócios, pré-vendas, inteligência comercial ou funções correlatas; Experiência na leitura e interpretação de documentos técnicos, editais, termos de referência e processos concorrenciais; Capacidade de elaborar propostas técnicas e documentos executivos de forma clara, objetiva e estruturada; Experiência na construção de matrizes de aderência funcional e análise de requisitos; Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal; Perfil analítico, organizado e orientado a resultados; Facilidade para interação com diferentes áreas da empresa e stakeholders externos. Diferenciais Experiência no segmento de concessões rodoviárias, mobilidade, transporte ou infraestrutura; Conhecimento sobre processos regulatórios e atuação de agências reguladoras; Vivência em empresas de tecnologia e software; Vivência com gestão de oportunidades e processos de pré-vendas; Conhecimento em metodologias de levantamento de requisitos e análise de negócios. Informações adicionais VA/VR Flexível — R$ 858,00/mês; Plano de saúde SulAmérica (subsídio mensal de R$ 440,00 e sem coparticipação); Plano odontológico SulAmérica; Atendimento psicológico por meio da Tele-psicologia; Day Off no dia do aniversário + vale presente de R$ 100,00; Auxílio Cultura — R$ 50,00/mês; Seguro de vida Icatu; Wellhub (Gympass) para titular + dependentes. Parcerias e Convênios Universidade Veiga de Almeida — graduação e pós-graduação; Open English — cursos de inglês e espanhol; Salão de Beleza conveniado — desconto em serviços; Movida — aluguel de veículos com condições especiais; Convênio com o SESC; Descontos com o Grupo de Hotéis Fazenda Montanhês. Outros Vale-transporte. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Líder de Atendimento - Copacabana
description: Descrição da vaga Somos um Grupoformado por marcas que possuem mais de 45 anos de experiência na área da saúde, e estamos presentes nos estados do Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, Paraná e Ceará, realizando mais de 456 mil consultas anuais e cuidando da vida de mais de 100 mil pacientes. Nossa identidade foi construída equilibrando ofoco em pessoas com uma gestão eficiente, por isso, valorizamos profissionais que sejam curiosos, acolhedores, que tenham calor humano, que transmitam confiança, mas que também sejam eficientes, ágeis, assertivos, orientados a resultados e processos. Somos movidos pelo propósito de criar um Brasil ativo e sem dor, transformando relações na saúde, oferecendo um ecossistema de excelência a pacientes com doenças musculoesquelético e de terapia assistida. Estamos em transformação e buscamos profissionais que queiram fazer parte da nossa história, mas para trabalhar conosco você precisa se reconhecer nos nossos valores: FOCO NAS PESSOAS Nossosvalores Pessoas são o nosso DNA: Somos justos nas relações com os pacientes, colegas de trabalho, parceiros e prestadores de serviço. Incentivamos sonhos e valorizamos as pessoas por suas competências. Simplificamos para fazer bem feito: Antecipamos os problemas e buscamos realizar as atividades da forma mais eficiente, agindo de imediato e de forma coordenada com foco na solução. Queremos mais: Buscamos incansavelmente a evolução, valorizando feedbacks e nos preocupando em sempre entregar a melhor experiência. Empoderamos as pessoas: Somo proativos para solucionar problemas e buscar oportunidades, assumimos responsabilidade pelas atividades exercidas, sem transferi-la para outros. Se você quer fazer a diferença, achou o lugar certo! title: Head of Customer Proposition
description: About the Role We are on a mission to pioneer the world’s next era of play. As we grow across Europe and Latin America, we’re building The Playstack - the technology powering the next generation of sports, gaming, and fan experiences. Join us, and help make it the most widely used platform in the world! From operations, to marketing, to product, we are looking for talented people who will shape how millions of customers play, watch, and connect every day. Not remote: This is a hybrid role in São Paulo or Rio de Janeiro. We are looking for a commercially driven and customer-centric Head of Customer Proposition to join our Brazil team. In this role, you will be responsible for leading the local 360° customer proposition strategy across our core product verticals, including Sports, Gaming and Social . As a senior leader within the Brazil Commercial organisation, you will oversee the ideation, development and execution of market-leading propositions that attract, engage, reward and retain customers throughout their lifecycle. You will lead a team of local product vertical experts and work cross-functionally to ensure our customer experiences are locally relevant, insight-led and commercially impactful. Working closely with the Commercial Director, Brazil, and wider regional and global stakeholders, you will shape and execute the local proposition strategy aligned to broader regional objectives, ensuring we deliver standout experiences that strengthen customer loyalty, increase engagement and drive sustainable growth in the Brazilian market. This role requires a deep understanding of the Brazilian betting and gaming landscape, strong commercial acumen, and a passion for delivering best-in-class customer experiences through innovation, personalisation and operational excellence. What You’ll Be Doing Define and lead the Brazil customer proposition strategy across Sports, Gaming and Social verticals, aligned to wider regional and global business objectives. Develop and execute a local proposition roadmap that enhances customer engagement, retention, cross-sell and lifetime value. Lead and develop a high-performing team of vertical managers/leads, fostering a culture of innovation, accountability and customer obsession. Partner with senior commercial and marketing stakeholders to identify strategic opportunities, market trends and competitive advantages within the Brazilian market. Customer Lifecycle, Retention & Engagement Collaborate with CRM to oversee the development and optimisation of lifecycle and customer journeys across acquisition, onboarding, retention, reactivation and higher-value segments. Ensure generosity and customer value are delivered effectively throughout key customer moments and major sporting and entertainment events. Drive advanced segmentation and personalisation strategies to create relevant, timely, and differentiated customer experiences. Collaborate with CRM and Performance teams to build sophisticated, data-led communication plans that improve engagement and long-term retention. Commercial Performance & Optimisation Own the proposition bonus and promotional investment strategy across all verticals, ensuring strong budget governance, efficiency and ROI. Monitor and optimise proposition performance against key commercial KPIs including retention, conversion, cross-sell, active days, engagement and customer value. Lead the Test & Learn roadmap for Brazil, identifying and prioritising experiments that improve customer and commercial outcomes. Use customer insights, analytics, and market intelligence to continuously evolve proposition performance and identify new growth opportunities. Product & Cross-Functional Collaboration Work closely with Product, GTM, Commercial, BI, CRM, Performance Marketing, Operations and Brand teams to ensure seamless proposition delivery and execution. Ensure alignment between local commercial priorities and the central Sports, Gaming and Social product roadmaps. Support acquisition strategies by optimising propositions and promotional mechanics to improve marketing efficiency and conversion performance. Collaborate with Analytics and Performance teams to build best-in-class reporting frameworks and performance dashboards to inform strategic decision-making. Market & Regulatory Excellence Maintain a strong understanding of the Brazilian regulatory landscape and ensure all proposition activity complies with local requirements and responsible gaming standards. Stay informed on competitor activity, customer behaviours and emerging market trends to ensure propositions remain innovative and market-leading. Champion a customer-first approach across all proposition initiatives and touchpoints. What We’re Looking For Significant experience in a senior proposition or commercial leadership role, ideally within the iGaming, sports betting or digital e-commerce/fintech space. Strong knowledge of the Brazilian betting, gaming, and digital consumer landscape. Proven experience building and executing customer proposition and retention strategies across multiple verticals. Strong commercial and analytical acumen with experience managing promotional budgets and performance KPIs. Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior stakeholders. Proven track record of managing and developing high-potential teams and individuals. This role involves direct role management responsibility. Deep understanding of customer lifecycle management, segmentation, personalisation, cross-sell and engagement strategies. Experience leading Test & Learn initiatives and using data-driven insights to optimise customer and commercial performance. Ability to oversee complex cross-functional initiatives/projects to completion and deliver successful business outcomes Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management skills. Passion for innovation, customer experience, and delivering market-leading propositions. Preferred Experience Experience across Sportsbook, Casino/Gaming and Social or community-led products. Familiarity with onsite/crm tools, bonus engines, and customer analytics tools. Experience operating within a fast-paced, high-growth, and regulated environment. Understanding of responsible gaming principles and local compliance requirements in Brazil. About Super We are a global technology group, dedicated to building the future of entertainment and fan-centric experiences. With commercial markets in Brazil, Belgium, Poland, Romania, Greece and Serbia, and a network of offices across Spain, Croatia, Malta, Gibraltar, the Netherlands and the UK, we are a truly international organization. Our purpose at Super has evolved from sports and betting into creating the platform that stretches into the wider world of technology-driven entertainment. With a growing and diverse team of more than 5,000 people, we create immersive, responsible, and personalised experiences for millions of customers worldwide. Shaping the Future of Play Everything we do at Super is rooted in doing what is right: for customers, for each other, and for our long-term vision. Our Culture Manifesto is our North Star. It captures our purpose, mission, and the six core beliefs that shape how we think, make decisions, and act every day. Want to explore our culture in more detail? Visit our careers page: super.xyz/careers Super is committed to the highest standards of compliance, safety, and responsibility. As such, we are active members of the International Betting Integrity Association (IBIA) and the European Gaming & Betting Association (EGBA). At Super, we operate as a high-performing team. We hire and grow talent based on ability and potential, regardless of background and identity because we know diverse perspectives, drive better performance. This position is based in Sao Paulo or Rio de Janeiro. In your daily routine, you will be led 100% in English. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Mechanical & Rotating Engineer
description: Airswift is seeking a Mechanical and Rotating Equipment Engineer (Onshore) to work in Rio de Janeiro in a permanent position with an Oil and Gas Company. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Act as a Technical Authority (Integrity) to evaluate and respond to Management of Change (MOC) and Technical Assistance (TA) requests. Lead Root Cause Failure Analysis (RCFA/RCA) and develop reliability and maintenance strategies for rotating equipment (pumps, compressors, turbines, gearboxes, and dry gas seal systems), ensuring compliance with company standards and international codes, increasing MTBF and reducing downtime. Evaluate, respond to, and approve MOC/TA requests, technical changes, and deviations, ensuring compliance with company standards and applicable regulations (API/ASME/ISO/ABNT). Issue Technical Notes and Guidelines as a recognized subject matter expert, standardizing practices and lessons learned. Ensure complete documentation, traceability, and clear communication with onshore/offshore stakeholders. Monitor the performance of rotating equipment using PDM/CBM techniques: vibration analysis, thermography, and oil analysis (including ferrography and spectroscopy) for early anomaly detection. Supervise and execute Product/Performance Data Monitoring (PDM) services, recommending corrective and preventive actions. Develop and implement condition-based maintenance (CBM) programs to optimize availability and reduce downtime. Develop and implement reliability and maintenance (RCM) strategies, with preventive/predictive plans to improve MTBF and lifecycle cost. Perform diagnostics on pumps, centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, gearboxes, and dry gas seal systems; recommend corrective actions. Identify and manage problematic components, conduct disposal plans, and prioritize investments to sustain reliability improvements. Lead the ACR for recurring failures and problems using structured methodologies (5 Whys, Ishikawa, TapRooT, etc.); issue actionable reports and verify the effectiveness of actions. Conduct component failure analyses (seals, bearings, rotors, gears, shafts) and propose design, operational, or maintenance improvements. Provide daily technical support to Operations and Maintenance areas to resolve machine problems, unplanned downtime, and optimize control/operating parameters. Offer guidance for commissioning/start-up, operations, reviews, and updates of controls/monitoring for rotating equipment. Support capital projects by reviewing maintainability and reliability specifications and ensuring correct installation/alignment according to API/AGMA/ISO standards. Support the preparation of Technical Risk Assessments (ART) and contribute to the continuous improvement of processes and systems. JOB QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering. MBA/Postgraduate degree in Reliability, Maintenance, or Asset Management is a plus. Advanced English required. Experience in operation, maintenance, or reliability of rotating equipment in the Oil and Gas sector (offshore/onshore), focusing on centrifugal/reciprocating compressors, pumps, and turbomachinery. Solid knowledge of rotating equipment reliability, RCM, CBM, and PDM services. Hands‑on experience in condition monitoring (vibration, oil analysis, thermography) and fault diagnosis. Proven experience in troubleshooting and field condition monitoring. Solid knowledge of API standards (e.g., 610/617/618/670/682/686), machine design, lubrication, mechanical seals (including dry gas seals). Rotor dynamics, balancing, alignment, and modal analysis. Practical knowledge of international codes and standards (ASME, ANSI, ISO 10816/20816). In‑depth knowledge of rotating equipment: pumps, compressors, dry gas seal systems, and gearboxes. Certification in vibration analysis (e.g., ISO CAT II/III) desirable; certifications in oil analysis/thermography are an advantage. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Captain
description: The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Basic Function The purpose of this position is to assist in the management of the Department of Public Safety (DPS) by providing administrative oversight and assisting in policy development. It may be designated Shift Commander and provide supervision and coordination over the daily operations of assigned personnel in keeping with established goals and objectives of the Department of Public Safety serving the Howard University and Howard University Hospital (HUH). SUPERVISORY Acts in a senior management capacity over other positions; orienting and training others, and assigning and reviewing their work. Accountability Internal contacts include academic and medical executives, administrators, faculty, students, and staff of the University and Hospital. External contacts include parent/guardians, patients, Mayoral Command Post, representatives from local and national Homeland security operations, social service agencies, special police officers, Security Officer’s Management Branch, members of the local criminal justice system to include Metropolitan Police, U.S. Attorney’s Office, Department of Corrections, Youth Services organizations, etc. and the general public. Principal Accountabilities Serves as a Commander over a large section or Division of the Howard University/HUH Department of Public Safety Operation; responsible for all operations in assigned sector on a 24 hour per day basis; administers comprehensive security programs to prevent crimes against persons and property on University Campus and HUH. Provides supervision and oversight over the duties of Deputy Shift Commander in shift operations to ensure that duties involving training and overseeing patrol activities, e.g. directing traffic, controlling crowds; securing facilities are conducted successfully. Works with higher management to develop procedures and directives, rules and regulations for the effective operations of the Department of Public Safety Police force within the guidelines of University, HUH, Federal and Municipal Governments’ laws and statutes. Prepares high level administrative reports, provides statistical data, reviews all incident reports; advises HUH and University management on security issues. Makes comprehensive plans to coordinate special events with the DC Office of Emergency Preparedness, Homeland Security or other federal or municipal agency; takes appropriate actions in response to unforeseen or unexpected incidents; ensures compliance with applicable policy, laws, rules and regulations; maintains emergency plans and makes determination as to when plans should be employed. May manage and coordinate plans and set priorities for fiscal activities of entire Department of Public Safety or may supervise and assist in the preparation of the annual budget for assigned sector; submits recommendations to management for review; may participate in the selection and evaluation process of new employees. Assists in establishing performance metrics consistent with the duties and responsibilities for the Department of Public Safety and HUH. Periodically inspects departments, facilities, equipment and personnel to ensure their safety and compliance with Department of Public Safety policies and procedures. Makes long term projection for labor distribution to ensure that critical areas are covered; provides instruction to immediate subordinates in the proper performance of their duties. May coordinate the acquisition and maintenance of Police equipment; direct the issuance of equipment and ensures accountability for equipment materials and supplies including automobiles, communication equipment, uniforms etc. May confer with management, to review achievements and discuss changes in long and short range goals and objectives; may monitor and plan the training schedule for in-house and outside agencies; maintain expiration roster and prepares license renewal for officers. Responds in person to the most serious incidents when called by subordinates to incidents occurring on University or HUH property; establishes a Field Command Post to supervise and direct police activities; meets with outside law enforcement and regulatory agencies. Assists the Chief and Deputy Chief with various policy, fiscal, budgetary, human resources and other administrative matters as required. May serve in the absence of the Deputy Chief as required. Performs other job-related duties as assigned by the Chief of the Department of Public Safety or other relevant authority. Core Competencies Extensive knowledge of criminal law, including elements of offenses, rules of evidence, laws of arrest, search and seizures, methods of law enforcement, maintenance of public safety and security, and related law enforcement principles. Extensive knowledge of current departmental, municipal and governmental policies and procedural changes relating to security. Ability to demonstrate expertise in hospital safety and security principles and practices in order to effectively assist in the directing of the Hospital’s safety and security programs and activities. Ability to maintain and provide a general source of University, Hospital and community information. General knowledge of computer programs, to include word processing, spreadsheet, database and presentation software. Enhanced skills in the use of firearms and other standard police equipment with the ability to secure a Special Police Officer Commission with firearm authorization from the District of Columbia. Enhanced skills in the use of both oral and written English with the ability to read technical literature, write investigative reports and to express complex cases and relationships orally and written forms. Excellent skill in public and customer relations with the ability to use tact, diplomacy and decorum. Ability to make public presentations, to negotiate and to successfully navigate internal and external politics. Ability to direct others in the investigative process and to provide leadership, training and direction to subordinates. Ability to remain emotionally stable and to display mature judgment and tact in explosive and/or dangerous situations. Ability to work a flexible schedule and be on call during a 24 hour a day, seven days per week timeframe. Ability to establish and maintain harmonious and effective work relations with staff, students, university officials, faculty, other public safety organizations; and the general public. Minimum Requirements Bachelor’s Degree in Law Enforcement, Criminal Justice or closely related field and four (4) years of work experience which included three (3) years at a supervisory level or the equivalent combination of eight (8) years combined relevant training and experience. Note: This position description should not be construed to imply that these requirements are the exclusive standards of the position. Incumbents will follow any other instructions, and perform any other related duties, as may be required. The university has the right to revise this position description at any time. This position description is not be construed as a contract for employment. Compliance Salary Range Disclosure Expected Pay Range: $80,000 to $85,000 #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Site Security and Audit Coordinator
description: Site Security and Audit Coordinator Department: Administration Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time Location: Brazil Reporting To: Fernanda Trinta Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. The role develops and implements patrimonial security and asset protection plans, establishes 24/7 security protocols during the Exclusive Use Period (EUP), and ensures that deployed security resources and stewarding operations are transparent, verifiable and compliant with FIFA regulations and contractual agreements. The position safeguards both operational integrity and financial accountability by managing deployment information, maintaining the stadium "Blue Book", hosting and validating event stewarding information, and conducting audits and compliance checks throughout tournament operations. Develop patrimonial security and asset protection plans for FIFA assets at each stadium, including overlay, branding, broadcast and restricted operational areas Define and implement 24/7 security protocols during the Exclusive Use Period (EUP), ensuring continuous protection of FIFA property and sensitive areas Establish and monitor robust perimeter control, access control and asset safeguarding measures aligned with risk assessments and FIFA standards Manage deployment information for each stadium, including security staffing levels, steward allocations and shift structures Hold, manage and continuously update the official stadium "Blue Book," ensuring accuracy and structured sharing with relevant functional areas (e.g. Finance, Operations) Host and maintain event stewarding information, ensuring that stewarding numbers, roles, qualifications and deployment models are clearly documented and validated Develop, maintain and regularly update detailed dot plans reflecting security and steward deployment positions, resource allocations and operational coverage at stadium level Prepare daily verification protocols for each day of the Exclusive Use Period to ensure that supplier invoices correspond to actual deployed security and stewarding resources Verify installation, attendance and deployment reports against contractual requirements and approved resource plans Identify discrepancies in deployment or billing and coordinate corrective actions with suppliers and internal stakeholders Arrange for and/or conduct structured audits, inspections and compliance checks during tournament time Assess compliance with FIFA Stadium Safety & Security Regulations, operational policies and contractual obligations Provide structured audit reports and assurance updates to the Senior Manager, Stadiums Support the Senior Manager, Stadiums with related administrative tasks, documentation control and reporting requirements Contribute to the drafting, review and maintenance of relevant policies and procedures relating to asset protection, deployment governance and stadium-level security operations Monitor implementation of corrective actions and support continuous improvement of asset protection and deployment governance processes Support operational readiness validation prior to each EUP phase and matchday YOUR PROFILE Education University degree or higher qualification in security management, risk management, business administration, audit, finance, data management or a related field Experience Minimum 3-5 years of experience in physical security, asset protection, compliance, deployment governance or venue security operations Demonstrated experience managing large-scale operational deployment data or similar Proven experience conducting audits, inspections or compliance reviews in multi-site or major event settings Experience verifying operational resource allocation against contractual and financial documentation Experience working with private security suppliers, stewarding providers and venue operators Skills & Competencies Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including pivot tables, complex formulas and structured data management Experience using macros and/or VBA to automate and manage large datasets desirable Strong analytical and numerical skills with high attention to detail Ability to design and maintain deployment tracking and verification systems Structured reporting capability for senior management High integrity when handling sensitive operational and financial information Strong organisational and coordination skills Clear written and verbal communication skills Advanced IT proficiency including MS Office suite, including PowerPoint and Word Certifications & Requirements Right to live and work in Brazil Willingness to travel nationally and work extended hours during tournament periods Fluency in Portuguese (spoken and written); working knowledge of English is essential #J-18808-Ljbffr

This role focuses on key industries such as data centers, life sciences, food & beverage, automotive, and other measurement‑intensive industrial sectors. What’s Your Role? Develop and execute strategic sales plans to achieve revenue and profitability targets, while expanding Vaisala’s presence and installed base across the territory. Proactively identify, target, and acquire new customers in key industries (data centers, life sciences, food & beverage, automotive, and other measurement‑intensive industries) within the South LAM region. Work closely with existing distributors to strengthen their sales and technical capabilities, and actively support the identification, recruitment, and onboarding of new partners, in collaboration with the Channel Partner Manager. Deliver impactful technical and commercial presentations, demos, and training to customers, partners, and associations, clearly articulating the value of Vaisala’s Industrial Instruments. Oversee the entire sales process from lead qualification to closing deals, ensuring a seamless customer experience. Utilize Salesforce to track sales activities and customer interactions. Work closely with internal stakeholders (local and international), including product management, marketing, customer service, and field service, to align sales efforts with company objectives and secure customer satisfaction. Monitor market trends, customer needs, and competitor activities in target industries, and provide structured feedback to support portfolio and strategy development. What Will You Bring? Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (electrical, electronic, automation, mechanical, or related field). 5–10 years of experience in technical sales within industrial markets, ideally selling instrumentation, sensors, automation, or related solutions to process or manufacturing industries. Proven track record of developing new business and consistently achieving or exceeding sales targets. Experience managing distributors or partners and building a structured partner network; OEM business development experience is a strong plus. Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills; comfortable presenting to both technical and management‑level stakeholders. High level of autonomy and self‑management, able to prioritize opportunities and manage a large territory. Availability to travel frequently across Brazil and South Cone countries, as required by the business. Fluent Portuguese and fluent English (written and spoken) are mandatory; Spanish language skills are a strong plus. Experience and discipline using CRM tools such as Salesforce. Residency in São Paulo – SP or surrounding areas, with availability for a hybrid work model (the office is in Vila Olimpia, São Paulo). What We Offer Competitive salary aligned with your experience and the market. Hybrid work model, combining office and home office. Flexible meal vouchers (Flash), compatible with regional standards. Full health and dental coverage (no coparticipation). Life insurance. An international, collaborative, and positive work environment, with opportunities to interact with global teams and develop your career in a high‑technology company. title: Change Manager, LATAM OU
description: Change Manager – Role Overview The Change Manager is crucial in shaping how people experience and contribute to change across Haleon. The role enables, coordinates and executes our strategic programmes, owning the local change strategy and roadmap within an assigned Operating Unit to ensure a coherent change experience. The role focuses on the people side of change – identifying, preparing, and equipping our colleagues to adopt changes in ways of working, roles, operating models, business processes, systems, technology, culture and more. It reports into the Change Management CoE Director and supports a collaborative effort to drive change excellence at scale. Key Responsibilities Drive the execution of strategic transformation initiatives landing in assigned Operating Unit by developing a change strategy and actionable roadmap. Conduct change diagnostics (e.g., impact assessments) to identify targeted change interventions and ensure alignment to Haleon’s culture strategy during planning and execution. Support the delivery and adoption of change through facilitating workshops, defining success metrics, assessing change effectiveness, measuring adoption, and coordinating local knowledge management plans. Partner with Programmes to develop local business readiness criteria ahead of going‑live with change initiatives. Hold programme and business leads accountable for leader‑led change execution. Anticipate stakeholder needs and potential resistance, proactively identifying targeted mitigations. Coordinate change activities across stakeholders and teams (HR, Communications, Programmes, Capability Leads, L&D, etc.) and act as a bridge between programmes and local teams. Develop and oversee the implementation of local communications and engagement plans, including mapping key stakeholders, agreeing the engagement approach with business leaders and HR, and tailoring programme change narratives for local needs. Build a holistic change capability strategy and plan for assigned Operating Unit, ensuring alignment to the enterprise skills framework. Develop and execute the change learning plan and curriculum with subject matter experts, partner with Programme leads, Capability Leads, and HR to identify training needs and ensure appropriate training plans are in place, including measuring effectiveness. Coach and upskill business leaders on change management, holding them to account for role‑modeling change and culture and driving uptake in their Operating Unit. Contribute to continuous improvement and knowledge sharing through the change management community of practice. Review and report on change outcomes and benefits, grounded in metrics, with clear ROI and linked to business outcomes. Identify, document and support the mitigation of key change management risks within the assigned Operating Unit and work across workstreams to implement interventions and resolve issues. Basic Qualifications Proven track record of executing change programs within complex, matrixed environments, demonstrating effectiveness across diverse global teams. Proficiency with portfolio‑level change management, including prioritisation, sequencing and operating across interdependent transformations. Ability to translate an enterprise‑level change strategy and roadmap into an executable and measurable local adoption plan. Strong understanding of change management best practices, tools and techniques, and practical implementation. Strong communication and relationship‑building skills, simplifying complex messages for business leaders. Strong problem‑solving and planning skills, working through ambiguity and adapting delivery approaches. Ability to influence and navigate across a broad ecosystem of stakeholders, including Leaders, Line Managers, HRBPs, L&D, etc. Preferred Qualifications PROSCI and/or APMG Change Practitioner certification (preferred). Strong business acumen and understanding of business operations and operating model components. Demonstrated ability to coach sponsors, cultivate change champions and drive business accountability for change. Solid understanding of how people experience change and drivers of change, embedding mindset and culture shifts across teams. Strong data fluency, leveraging analytics and insights to drive adoption; proficiency with change management, collaboration and digital adoption tools. Equal Opportunities Haleon is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates diverse perspectives and ensures fair and equitable outcomes for all. Our decision to hire is based solely on qualifications, experience, and fit for the role. We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected characteristic. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Coordenador de Marketing e Mídia – Foco em Brandformance
description: Buscamosum(a) Coordenador(a)deMídia(Brandformance) para integrar nosso equipe de Marketing, com foco na marca Estácio. Este profissional será fundamental para a construção e execução de estratégias de mídia que equilibrem a construção da marca e a geração de resultados diretos, em um ambiente dinâmico e focado em inovação no setor educacional. A posição exige um perfil analítico, estratégico e com capacidade de liderança, que consiga transitar entre o planejamento tático e a visão de negócio, garantindo a sinergia entre as ações de brand in performance. DESCRITIVODEATIVIDADES Garantir a conexão entre os objetivos de negócio de marca e as estratégias de mídia, atuando de forma integrada como mais áreas do Marketing. Responsável por garantir que a racional da estratégia de mídia esteja aplicada na linha criativa no business plan da marca; Construir recomendações estratégicas de investimento com base em dados de mercado, concorrência, comportamento do consumidor e resultados históricos. Atuar na identificação de oportunidades de crescimento de mercado por meio de estudos de audiência, pesquisas e análises competitivas. Desenvolvimento dos planos estratégicos de mídia (online e offline) em parceria com o time interno e agências de publicidade. Liderar fóruns de acompanhamento de campanhas junto às áreas internas, agência e parceiros estratégicos. Garantir alinhamento entre planejamento, execução, mensuração e prestação de contas dos investimentos de mídia. Avaliar tendências, formatos, tecnologias e oportunidades de inovação em mídia, propondo testes e projetos pilotos alinhados aos objetivos da marca. Definir e acompanhar indicadores de awareness, consideração e negócio, garantindo a correta mensuração da contribuição da mídia ao longo do funil. Realizar análises críticas de resultados e propor otimizações contínuas de estratégia, canais, audiência e investimentos. Apresentações executivas em nível senior. Realizar a gestão da equipe, desenvolvendo tecnicamente os colaboradores. REQUISITOSDAPOSIÇÃO Ensino Superior Completo, preferencialmente em Publicidade e Propaganda, Marketing, Administração e/ou áreas correlatas. Profundo conhecimento do mercado de mídia, com habilidades sólidas para definição de estratégias e negociações com veículos. Experiência prévia com gestão de campanhas de alta complexidade e orçamentos expressivos. Necessário experiência com planejamento de mídia full-funnel (online e offline); mínimo de 5 anos. Necessário conhecimento de métricas de mídia full-funnel. Conhecimento em ferramentas de atribuição (MTA) e/ou Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM). Conhecimento básico em Google Analytics (GA4) para análise de tráfego e comportamento. Necessário domínio técnico das plataformas de mídia paga e plataformas programáticas (Google Ads, DV360, Meta, TiktokAds) para saber criticar, promover melhorias. Proficiência no Pacote Office, com domínio avançado de PowerPoint para apresentações executivas. Deseja experiência com liderança ou orientação técnica de agência ou equipe própria. Desejável conhecimento em Pesquisa de Mídia (Ibope, Comscore e AdIntel). Desejável conhecimento de PowerBI. Desejável experiência em agências de publicidade. Certificações nas áreas são desejáveis. Experiência no segmento de educação será um diferencial. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Somos um Grupoformado por marcas que possuem mais de 45 anos de experiência na área da saúde, e estamos presentes nos estados do Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Paraná, Espirito Santo e Ceará realizando mais de 456 mil consultas anuais e cuidando da vida de mais de 100 mil pacientes.Nossa identidade foi construída equilibrando ofoco em pessoas com uma gestão eficiente, por isso, valorizamos profissionais que sejam curiosos, acolhedores, que tenham calor humano, que transmitam confiança, mas que também sejam eficientes, ágeis, assertivos, orientados a resultados e processos. Empoderamos as pessoas: Somos proativos para solucionar problemas e buscar oportunidades, assumimos responsabilidade pelas atividades exercidas, sem transferi-la para outros. Auxiliar no preparo e administração de medicamentos, conforme prescrição e atribuições legais da categoria. title: Integrity Engineer
description: Job Function: Employment Type: Permanent Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliver powerful solutions. Sumary: Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda is seeking a dedicated Integrity Engineer. This important role supports the onshore operations with a key focus on maintaining and assuring the integrity and safe operation of FPSOunits and associated equipment. As an Integrity Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the company’s interests by ensuring all inspection, testing, and maintenance activities on critical equipment are carried out with high standards of safety, compliance, and efficiency. You will be integral to a team committed to operational excellence and proactive risk management within the offshore oil and gas sector. Key Responsibilities Organise and oversee the activities related to NR 13 / SPIE compliance in collaboration with equipment inspectors from FPSO units, including maintaining comprehensive and up-to-date documentation such as official books, calibration certificates, inspection reports, and audit records. Manage internal and external inspection schedules, ensuring adherence to regulatory and company standards, while maintaining close coordination with operation managers to integrate inspection activities within shutdown plans effectively. Lead the evaluation and implementation of training programs for Equipment Inspectors, Operators, and Technicians to uphold competency and safety standards across all levels of operations. Maintain and regularly update the equipment master list to reflect current status and compliance details. Define testing, measurement, replacements, repairs, and modification schedules based on written procedures, ensuring the physical condition of critical equipment meets operational safety requirements. Ensure rigorous verification and performance testing of safety valves and other safety-critical equipment, either by performing, witnessing, or overseeing such tests to guarantee reliable operation. Conduct audits of equipment manufacturers as required, supporting thorough supplier qualification and quality assurance. Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders (Yinson teams) and external parties (clients, contractors) to foster transparent communication and alignment on objectives and compliance requirements. Perform additional duties as assigned by management in support of the company’s goals and regulatory compliance. Commercial Awareness: Understand the wider business context and how operational integrity relates to company performance and risk management. Safeguarding Company Interest: Demonstrate commitment to protecting company assets, reputation, and operational continuity. Cost Control Experience: Apply cost control principles within offshore oil and gas projects to optimise expenditure without compromising safety or quality. Teamwork: Work collaboratively across multi-disciplinary teams and with external partners, fostering a positive and productive working environment. Communication Skills: Communicate effectively at all organisational levels, both verbally and in writing, ensuring clarity and professionalism in all interactions. Analytical and Problem-Solving Abilities: Use strong analytical skills to assess equipment conditions, interpret inspection data, and develop practical solutions. Attention to Detail: Maintain accuracy in documentation, procedures, and reporting to support compliance and operational excellence. Responsibility and Proactivity: Take ownership of tasks, demonstrate initiative, and work in a hands‑on manner to achieve targets and resolve issues promptly. Qualifications and Experience Engineering degree is mandatory. CREA‑RJ accreditation is required. Post‑Graduation degree in a relevant field will be considered a strong advantage. Experience as an Operations Engineer within the Brazilian oil and gas sector, with experience specifically in integrity engineering preferred. Proven experience working with FPSO projects and offshore operations is highly desirable. Fluent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication skills to effectively liaise with diverse teams and stakeholders. Why Join Us? At Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda, you will become part of a forward‑thinking and inclusive team dedicated to safe and sustainable offshore operations. We value initiative and provide opportunities for professional growth within a dynamic sector. Our collaborative culture encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement, enabling you to make a tangible impact in a challenging and rewarding environment. If you are a focused, detail‑oriented professional with a strong commitment to equipment integrity and operational safety, and you thrive in a team‑oriented setting, this role offers an excellent platform to advance your career in offshore production. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Bring your unique energy to our team of more than 21,000 people worldwide, and discover a rewarding, fulfilling, and varied career that you can take in anywhere you want to go. Job Purpose We are looking for a Senior Process Control Engineer! We are seeking a motivated Senior Engineer to join our global team specializing in Process Control for subsea oil and gas process systems. Process Control is a core competency in the Power & Processing (P&P) department. They are responsible for developing and designing the automation system controlling the subsea processing equipment, including control algorithms and operating procedures to ensure safe and efficient operation. The Senior Process Control Engineer works as part of the system engineering team to ensure that the subsea processing equipment operates within its design limitations and that the system operation is robust and efficient. The work requires a thorough understanding of multiphase processing with expertise in process control and the design and implementation of closed loop control. To achieve this, the process control engineer collaborates closely with process, rotating equipment, high voltage power, flow assurance, instrumentation and control system disciplines within TechnipFMC. Job Description Provide a high level of expertise on technical solutions and engineering innovations as the Process Control Lead Engineer in studies, FEEDs, tenders, projects and aftermarket service engineering. Define the process control strategy, identify and analyse risks associated with operation and control of the system. Write functional specifications and test procedures for implementation and testing. Develop and review safety requirements for the system at HAZOP and LOPA meetings with Clients. Facilitate and lead internal and external meetings, reviews and project face‑to‑face meetings towards the client and sub suppliers as required. Follow up Dynamic process simulation studies to verify system and process control functions. Efficiently contribute to the project delivery phase through presentations, meetings and interfaces towards other key internal project packages. Lead or support function testing of the subsea process control implemented in delivery or R&D projects. Participate and support as TechnipFMC representative during offshore commissioning and start‑up. Provide operational support and consultation for problem solving and performance improvement as part of Life‑of‑Field service for Subsea Processing projects. Support the knowledge development within the discipline. Travel, both locally and internationally, should be expected. You are meant for this job if: You have a BSc, MSc or PhD within Cybernetics, Chemical Engineering or a similar education with a strong focus on Process Control engineering. At least 10 years relevant experience. Experience can compensate for lack of formal education. Experience with subsea process systems and products such as pumps and separators. Experience designing and implementing process control in oil and gas systems. Experience in interfacing other sub‑systems; especially Controls/Instruments, Flow Assurance, Process Engineering and Field Development. Experience with development and testing of process system components and full system solutions. Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills. Excellent communication and teamwork abilities. Willingness to learn, a growth mindset, and can adapt to a dynamic work environment. Fluent in English, (C1 or higher according to CEFR). Your Future at TechnipFMC Your journey starts with our onboarding program. As an international company, we provide you with great opportunities for internal growth. You will have the opportunity to attend development activities. We have benefits like company cabins, in‑house gym, and sports teams. You will be secured by good insurance and retirements plans. Collaborative and innovative atmosphere that promotes teamwork. Practicalities Deadline to apply: 29th of June 2026, we view CV's continously. Legal Information Being a global leader in the energy industry requires an inclusive and diverse environment. TechnipFMC promotes equal opportunities and inclusion by ensuring equal opportunities to all ages, races, ethnicities, religions, gender expressions, disabilities, or all other pluralities. We celebrate who you are and what you bring. Every voice matters and we encourage you to add to our culture. TechnipFMC respects the rights and dignity of those it works with and promotes adherence to internationally recognized human rights principles for those in its value chain. #J-18808-Ljbffr

validation;* Address prioritized demands according to defined criteria and guidelines.**Your Future at Kyndryl** As an IT Strategy Consultant at Kyndryl you will join the Kyndryl Consultant You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. **Required Skills and Experience*** Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Business Administration or Engineering.* Experience in: + Operations management; + Operational indicators (SLAs, backlog, response time, etc.); + Continuous process improvement; + Performance, productivity, and quality analysis;* Proven experience in root cause analysis;* Advanced knowledge of Excel and BI tools (Power BI or similar);* Strong communication, organizational skills, and critical process thinking;* Analytical mindset and data-driven approach;* Systems thinking with a focus on continuous improvement;* Strong prioritization and organizational skills;* Ability to communicate and collaborate across teams;* Proactivity and sense of ownership.* Availability to work during standard business hours (Monday to Friday, 5x2);* **Work location: Rio de Janeiro/RJ (100% on-site).**## Preferred Skills and Experience* Knowledge of ITIL (incident and problem management);* Familiarity with continuous improvement methodologies (Lean, Kaizen, PDCA);* Experience with Agile methodologies.**Being You**The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.**What You Can Expect**Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best. From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth. We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success. We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. You'll play a key role in delivering high-quality, personalized learning experiences as we continue to expand our reach globally. Job Summary Join our global team as an online teacher for IAS Economics (Cambridge Curricula) and immerse yourself in a premium one‑on‑one teaching environment. This flexible, remote role empowers you to create tailored learning experiences that meet each student’s unique needs, all from the comfort of your own home and on a schedule that fits your lifestyle. Utilize diverse teaching strategies and digital tools to create an engaging and supportive learning environment. Assess student progress, provide targeted feedback, and adjust teaching methods to ensure optimal learning outcomes. Plan and execute clear course schedules, detailing session content and assessment timelines. Conduct professional, interactive live sessions, leveraging online learning resources to enhance the educational experience. Set relevant homework, design and administer assessments, and provide constructive feedback to encourage student growth. Develop educational materials, including tests and exams, contributing to CGA’s rich resource library. Please note, while valuable, we are unable to count tutoring experience towards this requirement. A Bachelor’s degree or higher in the subject area you will be teaching. Exceptional communication skills for effective interaction with students, parents, and the CGA team. Familiarity with online teaching platforms and a passion for innovative education methods. Knowledge of the Cambridge, Edexcel or A‑Levels curricula and examinations. Preferred Qualifications Teaching qualification such as postgraduate certificate in education, degree in teaching, teaching license. Online teaching experience. About Crimson Global Academy CGA is a world‑class online school delivering live, real‑time learning to ambitious students around the world. With over 1000 students joining us from 65 countries, our vision is to unlock our students’ limitless potential, together, for extraordinary futures. We are doing this by: Igniting a passion for learning that accelerates academic performance and success regardless of age. Fostering a global community that broadens students’ perspectives and develops their skills to make a difference on the world stage. Providing cutting‑edge technology for teachers to launch students into their future while giving parents transparency into their child’s education. If you’re passionate about delivering personalized, impactful education in a flexible, one‑on‑one environment, Crimson Global Academy is the perfect fit for you. Join us in our mission to shape the future of learning, apply now! To learn more about our innovative approach, check out our newsletters and inspiring student success stories. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Analista de Inteligência de Negócios Sênior
description: ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história. A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes. Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país. E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras. Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades. Minimum of 2 years of work experience in the hospitality industry. Strong communication skills – oral and written. Experience coordinating complex projects. Strong organizational, customer service and attention to detail. Fluent/Native in English and Portuguese are required for this position. Knowledge of other languages is considered a plus. Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. Requirements Must have legal right to work in Brazil. Good understanding of application security and secure engineering practices. Leadership of engineering teams with 5+ direct reports and a track record of building and developing talent. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, operating with ownership and autonomy. Practice data‑driven decision making in delivery and engineering management. Ability to operate effectively in environments involving transaction‑heavy, reliability‑sensitive, or fintech‑related systems. Nice to Have Proficiency in more than one programming language. Experience with large‑scale distributed systems in high‑growth or high‑traffic environments. Exposure to travel tech, e‑commerce, marketplace, or fintech platforms. Understanding of data engineering or machine learning team environments. Prior experience hiring and scaling teams rapidly. Experience working on payments, financial systems, or other transaction‑focused platforms. Hiring Process Please review our Hiring Process Guidelines before your interview.
